newsitem.title: ITALY: OSCE's Vranitzky meets Albanian PM on warship. [CORRECTED 13:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: OSCE's Vranitzky meets Albanian PM on warship. [CORRECTED 13:05 GMT]

text.p: European mediator Franz Vranitzky began talks with Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino aboard an Italian warship in the Adriatic on Friday in an effort to halt violence in the Balkan state, the Italian Foreign Ministry said.

A spokesman said the meeting was taking place on the Italian frigate Aliseo (corrects name and type of ship from "amphibious assault ship San Giorgio"), where Vranitzky and Fino had been flown by helicopter.

A spokeswoman for Vranitzky's Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) mission earlier told reporters by telephone that the former Austrian chancellor was flying by helicopter to the ship from the Italian port of Brindisi.

She said he would meet senior Albanian officials, including Fino, appointed this week to head a national unity government, and Foreign Minister Arjan Starova. President Sali Berisha, she said, would not be in attendance.
The spokeswoman said it was hoped representatives of rebels in the southern port of Vlore would take part in the talks. Vlore was the scene of some of the worst violence to date.
Vranitzky met Berisha in Tirana last week and had urged him to avoid violence in dealing with the rebellion. A top-level European Union mission also came to Tirana.
